Notes: On-board IMU - recommend breakout for first build
Waterproof recommended - select based on harness design

Reference: External Harness Components (not on main board):
- All capacitors should be X7R or X5R ceramic with 10V+ rating
- Consider buying extras (caps/resistors) as they're easy to lose
- BMI160 breakout boards are easier to solder for beginners
- GPS module typically includes antenna - external antenna optional
- Waterproof connectors recommended for bike application (wet conditions)
- Use marine-grade heat shrink for harness weatherproofing
